title: P25: three radios taking turns on a talkgroup
description: P25 Phase 1 C4FM voice calls on 453.6125 MHz, NAC 0x293, TG 101 (HDU, LDU1 link control with the source unit ID, LDU2 clear, placeholder IMBE frames with valid FEC, TDU / TDULC): unit 2010621 (60 deg) twice, unit 3250 (200 deg), unit 1234567 (300 deg), each at its own carrier offset and level. Expect talkers 2010621, 3250 and 1234567 at those bearings.

title: P25 Phase 2: three radios' inbound bursts, two of them at the same time
description: P25 Phase 2 TDMA inbound (radios to the site, H-CPM bursts) on 453.6125 MHz, scrambled (WACN BEE00 / system 14C / NAC 293, recovered by the decoder from the bursts): unit 6001 -> TG 601 on logical channel 0 (40 deg, +200 Hz) and, at the same time, unit 6002 -> TG 602 encrypted (AES-256, muted) on logical channel 1 (160 deg, -150 Hz, 3 dB weaker) - their 28 ms bursts alternate every 30 ms; then unit 6003 -> TG 601 on logical channel 0 (280 deg, +50 Hz). Each radio names itself (MAC_PTT, voice channel user, MAC_END_PTT) and its bursts are its packets. Expect talkers 6001, 6002 and 6003 at those bearings.

title: P25 Phase 2: a site's traffic channel with calls on both timeslots, then a Phase 1 call
description: A P25 Phase 2 TDMA traffic channel (H-DQPSK, the site at 120 deg, +140 Hz) on 854.7625 MHz, scrambled (WACN BEE00 / system 14C / NAC 293, recovered by the decoder from a traffic burst): unit 2101 -> TG 101 in the clear on logical channel 0, overlapping it unit 2102 -> unit 2103 encrypted (AES-256, muted) on logical channel 1; then the same channel carries a P25 Phase 1 call of unit 2104 -> TG 101. On the site's output every unit's bearing is the site's. Expect talkers 2101, 2102 and 2104 at 120 deg.

title: P25 trunking: a control channel and three calls on traffic channels (two Phase 1, one Phase 2)
description: A P25 Phase 1 control channel (TSDUs of three trunking blocks, NAC 0x2A1, WACN A1B2C / system 3D4, RFSS 3 site 7) on 851.8000 MHz = channel 1-64 (bearing 300 deg), announcing identifier 1 (FDMA, 851.000 MHz + 12.5 kHz, uplink -45 MHz) and 2 (TDMA, 2 slots, the same plan). Grants, each 0.3-0.4 s before its call and repeated as grant updates through it: TG 1201 <- 1001001 on 1-8 = 851.1000 MHz (1.0 s; the call 1.4-4.6 s at 40 deg, a TDU, then the system's call termination TDULCs at 5.6 s), TG 1305 <- 1001002 encrypted (service options 0x40; AES-256 ALGID 0x84, muted) on 1-48 = 851.6000 MHz (5.2 s; 5.6-8.8 s at 200 deg, released at 9.8 s), TG 1402 <- 1001003 on 2-57 = 851.3500 MHz timeslot 1 (8.8 s; a Phase 2 carrier from 8.9 s at 120 deg, the call on LCH 1 9.2-11.7 s, hang time, MAC_END_PTT, then MAC_IDLE). Expect on VFO 0 the system A1B2C.3D4 and the three grants with their frequencies; with trunk following a voice VFO per call, talkers 1001001 at 40 deg, 1001002 at 200 deg (muted), 1001003 at 120 deg (LCH 1).
